title: 石头有多老
subtitle: 一层一层压出来的时间
character: wearing a rust red t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in mineral pigment style, layered earthy washes with fine dark outlines, ochre, rust red, slate grey and cream, textured and grainy

pages.zh:
我在路边捡到一块石头，
上面有一道一道的纹。
爸爸说，
这块石头比我老得多。
到底有多老呢？
pages.scene: The little boy crouches on a path holding a striped stone in both hands, looking at it closely.

pages.zh:
石头分好几种。
有的是岩浆冷却变硬的，
有的是泥沙
一层一层压出来的，
还有的是被挤压变了样的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three rock shapes in a row on a cream background: one plain and solid, one with horizontal stripes, one with wavy bent stripes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
泥沙压出来的那种，
最会记时间。
每年河水带来一点泥沙，
一层一层铺上去，
慢慢压成石头。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cross-section on a cream background with eight horizontal layers stacked one on another, each a slightly different shade. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这些层叫「地层」。
越下面的越老，
越上面的越新。
数一数有几层，
就知道过了多久。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one stack of eight layers on a cream background with an arrow beside it pointing downward and the lowest layer marked with a thicker outline. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有时候地壳一挤，
本来平平的层
就被折成弯的，
甚至翻了个个儿。
山里常常能看见。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one stack of layers on a cream background bent into a smooth arch, with two arrows pressing in from the left and right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
小动物死掉以后，
有时候会被泥沙盖住。
肉烂掉了，
骨头和壳留在层里，
慢慢变成石头。
pages.scene: One cross-section on a cream background with a small shell shape embedded in one of the middle layers. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那就是化石。
找到化石，
就知道那一层形成的时候，
这里住着什么。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one stack of layers on a cream background with three different small shapes embedded at three different depths: a shell, a leaf and a bone. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
石头也会慢慢变。
水冻在缝里会把它撑开，
风沙天天磨，
树根也往缝里钻。
再硬的石头也扛不住。
pages.scene: One large boulder on a cream background with a visible crack running through it and a small root growing into the crack. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
碎掉的石头变成沙，
沙被水带走，
又铺到别的地方，
再压成新的石头。
就这样转个不停。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one circular loop of arrows on a cream background with three small symbols around it: a boulder, a heap of sand, and a layered rock. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地球上最老的石头，
有四十亿年那么老。
那时候还没有鱼，
没有树，
更没有人。
pages.scene: One plain dark rock on a cream background, drawn large and simple. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以捡石头的时候，
可以看看上面有没有纹，
有没有小小的壳。
那都是它
带来的消息。
pages.scene: One open hand on a cream background holding three small stones of different shapes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把那块石头
放在窗台上。
它躺在那里，
安安静静的。
可它已经等了很久很久。
pages.scene: The little boy places the striped stone carefully on a windowsill, looking at it, thoughtful.
